The devices are industrial-grade measuring tools featuring durable, block-like casings with prominent digital LED displays reading out measurements like "80.808" and "5.000". --- ## 1. Non-Contact Measurement Technology Laser series gauges through laser scanning measurement principal is the core technology for the device. A focused low power laser at high scanning rates through a measurement window across the object is the basic technique to accurately measure the product. The material, temperature and colour doesn't influence the measurement. The device is designed to measure transparent objects also. Specially crafted lens to maintain the accuracy and repeatability of the device. > **Image Description:** A technical diagram illustrating the laser scanning measurement principle. An "Emitter" projects an "Absolutely parallel" laser beam across a designated "Measuring field". The object being measured passes through this field, casting a shadow ("Measured dimension"). A receiver processes this shadow via "Laser scan with high rates" to create an "Output signal (Video)" which is then calculated using a "Counting Clock" to determine precise dimensions. --- ## 2. Features and Benefits - Using an advanced digital signal processor, LASER series sensor minimizes external inferences. - High accuracy and low drift measurements. - Rugged case construction sealed for longer life. - Flexible communication integration RS232/RS485 and other based on request. - It is less sensitive to product vibration and movements. - Digital outputs for integration like Alarm to notify errors through audio visual means. - Analogue output for further integration with machine for feedback and corrective action. --- ## 3.
